subScenes.name: 查询场次
subScenes.description: 询问电影放映时间与排片信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: What showtimes do you have for Avengers today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今天复仇者联盟有哪些场次？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问特定电影的放映时间

followUps.text: We have showings at 2 PM, 5 PM, and 8 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有下午2点、5点和8点的场次。

followUps.text: Sorry, the 8 PM show is sold out, but we have 2 PM and 5 PM left.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，晚上8点的场次已售罄，但下午2点和5点还有票。

followUps.text: We only have the 3D version at 5 PM and IMAX at 8 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们只有下午5点的3D版和晚上8点的IMAX版。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常用于查询热门电影的放映时间，服务员需明确场次、版本和余票状态。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to reserve seats or pick your own?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想预留座位还是自己选座？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 售票员询问顾客选座偏好

followUps.text: I'd like to reserve seats, please — middle row, center.
followUps.text_cn: 我想预留座位，请选中间排正中央。

followUps.text: Just pick the best available for me.
followUps.text_cn: 帮我选最好的位置就行。

followUps.text: Can I see the seating map first?
followUps.text_cn: 我能先看看座位图吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 售票员常用此句引导顾客选座，顾客回应应体现选座偏好或需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any discounts for students or seniors?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有学生或老人优惠吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问票价优惠资格

followUps.text: Yes, students get 20% off with a valid ID, and seniors over 65 get 15% off.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，凭有效学生证可享8折，65岁以上老人享85折。

followUps.text: We don't offer student discounts, but we have a 2 PM weekday special for $8.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有学生优惠，但工作日下午2点有特价票，仅8美元。

followUps.text: Sorry, no discounts today — it's a new release and all tickets are full price.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，今天没有优惠，这是新片上映，所有票都是全价。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常询问优惠，服务员需根据政策、日期和影片类型灵活回应。

subScenes.name: 确认票价
subScenes.description: 了解不同座位类型的票价差异。

qaPairs.triggerText: How much is the ticket for this show?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问当前场次票价，服务员回应后顾客选择支付方式

followUps.text: That’s $12 for adults, and $8 for children. I’ll take two adult tickets.
followUps.text_cn: 成人票12美元，儿童票8美元。我要两张成人票。

followUps.text: Is there a discount for students? I have my student ID.
followUps.text_cn: 学生有优惠吗？我有学生证。

followUps.text: Hmm, that’s a bit more than I expected. Do you have any matinee showings cheaper?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，比我想的贵一点。有便宜一点的下午场吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在得知票价后做出购买决策的典型回应，涵盖接受、询优惠、换时段三种真实反应

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to upgrade to 3D or IMAX?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员推荐升级观影体验，顾客根据偏好回应

followUps.text: Yes, I’ll take the IMAX version — I love the big screen!
followUps.text_cn: 要，我要IMAX的，我喜欢大银幕！

followUps.text: No thanks, the regular screen is fine. I’m on a budget.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，普通屏幕就行，我预算有限。

followUps.text: What’s the price difference? I’m not sure which one to pick.
followUps.text_cn: 价格差多少？我不确定选哪个。

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员推荐升级服务时，顾客的三种典型回应：接受、拒绝、犹豫需更多信息

qaPairs.triggerText: The regular ticket is $10, but the 3D costs $15. Which one would you like?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 普通票10美元，3D票15美元。您想要哪一种？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员明确给出两种票价选项，顾客做出选择

followUps.text: I’ll go with the 3D — it’s worth the extra $5.
followUps.text_cn: 我要3D的，多5美元值得。

followUps.text: I’ll take the regular one. I don’t really notice the difference.
followUps.text_cn: 我要普通票，我感觉不出差别。

followUps.text: Do you have any combo deals with popcorn? Maybe I’ll get the 3D if it’s cheaper with food.
followUps.text_cn: 有爆米花套餐优惠吗？如果和食物一起买能便宜点，我就选3D。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在明确价格对比下做出决策，涵盖价值判断、经济考量和捆绑优惠谈判三种真实行为

subScenes.name: 选择座位
subScenes.description: 提出座位偏好（如中间、靠窗等）。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like front, middle, or back seats?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想要前排、中排还是后排的座位？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 电影院售票员询问观众偏好座位区域

followUps.text: Front row, please—I love the immersive experience.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我前排的，我喜欢沉浸式体验。

followUps.text: Middle row is fine—I don’t want to strain my neck.
followUps.text_cn: 中排就行，我不想脖子酸。

followUps.text: Can you show me where the best views are? I’m not sure.
followUps.text_cn: 你能给我看看哪里视野最好吗？我不太确定。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在选座时回应影院工作人员的座位区域询问，体现个人观影偏好或需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you prefer aisle or center seats?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您更喜欢靠过道还是中间的座位？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 售票员进一步确认座位具体位置偏好

followUps.text: Aisle, please—I might need to get up during the movie.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我靠过道的，我可能看电影中途要起身。

followUps.text: Center, no matter what—I don’t want to miss anything.
followUps.text_cn: 中间的就行，我不想错过任何画面。

followUps.text: Is there any seat with extra legroom?
followUps.text_cn: 有腿部空间更大的座位吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客回应关于靠过道或中间座位的细节询问，体现对舒适性或观影体验的个性化需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: We have two seats together—would you like them side by side or across?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们有两张连座，您想要并排坐还是对面坐？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 售票员为同行顾客确认座位排列方式

followUps.text: Side by side—we want to watch the movie together.
followUps.text_cn: 并排坐，我们想一起看电影。

followUps.text: Across, please—I like to share snacks without leaning.
followUps.text_cn: 对面坐吧，我想分享零食但不想弯腰。

followUps.text: Actually, can we split up? I’ll sit alone.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我们分开坐吧，我自己坐一排。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客在购买双人票时回应座位排列方式的询问，体现社交互动或个人空间偏好变化。

subScenes.name: 支付购票
subScenes.description: 完成付款并领取电影票或电子码。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have bills today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只有现金。

followUps.text: Can I use Apple Pay? My card’s not working.
followUps.text_cn: 能用Apple Pay吗？我的卡刷不了了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于支付环节的常见询问，学习者需掌握多种支付方式的表达及应对突发状况（如卡片失效）

qaPairs.triggerText: That’ll be $12 total. Any popcorn or drinks to go with that?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 总共12美元。需要加点爆米花或饮料吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 购票后附加商品推荐环节

followUps.text: Yes, I'll take a large popcorn and a soda, please.
followUps.text_cn: 要，来份大份爆米花和一杯苏打水。

followUps.text: No thanks, I’m on a budget today.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，今天我预算有限。

followUps.text: Hmm, let me check the prices first.
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，让我先看看价格。

qaPairs.usageNote: 影院常见附加销售话术，学习者需能自然回应推荐，表达接受、拒绝或犹豫态度

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you book online or at the counter?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是在线订票还是在窗口买的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 核对购票方式以确认支付状态

followUps.text: I booked online, but I need to pick up the tickets here.
followUps.text_cn: 我在线订的，但需要在这里取票。

followUps.text: I paid right here at the counter.
followUps.text_cn: 我刚才在柜台付的钱。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—I got the ticket from my friend.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，票是我朋友给我的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于核对支付与取票流程，学习者需能清晰说明购票渠道及支付状态，避免取票纠纷

subScenes.name: 确认细节
subScenes.description: 核对电影名称、时间与座位号无误。

qaPairs.triggerText: What time would you like to watch?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 电影院购票 - 确认观影时间

followUps.text: The 7:30 PM show, please.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我晚上7:30的场次。

followUps.text: Is there anything after 9 PM? I’m running late.
followUps.text_cn: 有晚上9点之后的场次吗？我可能会晚到。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m not sure—what’s the least crowded showing?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我不确定——哪一场人最少？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于确认观影时间，常见于购票流程中，用户可能直接选择、请求调整或寻求建议。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 电影院购票 - 确认影片格式

followUps.text: 2D is fine, thanks. I don’t need 3D.
followUps.text_cn: 2D就可以了，谢谢，我不需要3D。

followUps.text: 3D, please—but is there an extra charge?
followUps.text_cn: 请给我3D的，但有额外费用吗？

followUps.text: Hmm, I’ve never seen 3D before—what’s the difference?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，我从没看过3D，有什么区别？

qaPairs.usageNote: 购票时确认影片格式，用户可能直接选择、询问价格或因不了解而寻求建议。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 电影院购票 - 确认购票数量

followUps.text: Two, please.
followUps.text_cn: 两张，谢谢。

followUps.text: Actually, one more person might join—can I buy three and change later if needed?
followUps.text_cn: 可能还有一人要来——我可以先买三张，之后再改吗？

followUps.text: Just one—but do you have any discounts for students?
followUps.text_cn: 一张就行——你们有学生优惠吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 确认购票数量时，用户可能直接说明、因人数变动请求弹性处理，或结合优惠询问。
